blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A man, who allegedly held a grudge against a motorcycle-for-hire driver (habal-habal driver) over a near-sideswiping incident involving the man’s mother, shot and killed the driver on Sunday afternoon, October 25, in Purok Buongon, Barangay Malolos, Barili town, southwestern Cebu. The suspect was arrested on Monday, October 26, at his residence in Barangay Tuyokon, Aloguinsan town in southwestern Cebu during a hot-pursuit operation of the police.
